metrics.gain: G(k)=sum(TY/e-(1-T)Y/(1-e)) over top k divided by N
metrics.uplift_at_k: sum of pseudo-outcomes over top k divided by k
metrics.auuc: Trapezoidal integral of G(k) over k/N including origin and endpoint
metrics.qini_coefficient: Area of Q(k)-(k/N)Q(N); unsupported initial prefixes are omitted
metrics.uncertainty: Pointwise independent-row Wald approximation at fixed scores and propensity. No multiplicity adjustment.
metrics.criteo: Released-benchmark approximation using the validation assignment share. Original propensities are unavailable.
